verdict.rationale: Temporal explicitly supports Signals, Queries, and Updates as first-class message-passing mechanisms into a running Workflow Execution, which can be triggered from an API call, webhook handler, or another workflow via the client SDK. This directly matches the human-in-the-loop story of injecting external events into a live workflow. Missing for 10: no direct evidence of webhook-specific integration patterns or independent hands-on confirmation of signal delivery reliability at scale.
